description: This script manages the execution of a test suite using Vitest, wrapping the process spawn, environment variable configuration, command-line argument parsing, and heartbeat monitoring to ensure the process is still active. It appears to be used for live testing and includes functions for handling quiet mode overrides and process signals.

methods.name: parsePositiveInt
methods.description: Parses a string value into a positive integer, returning a fallback value if the input is invalid or non-positive.
